items.label: Pennsylvania income tax
items.note: A flat 3.07% of wages with no standard deduction.

items.note: Residents pay 3.74% to 30 June 2026 and 3.735% from 1 July, so 3.7375% across the calendar year, on all compensation (Medicare wages, including 401(k) deferrals).
